lines.text: Unlocks: Clear event stage 102210108 · After Cats make the world go 'round. chat 1. Nero has invited {AccountData.NickName} to joi…

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Apparently, Ruru decided to finally come to the shelter.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: That's great news!

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I've gotta start thinking about all the things I wanna do with her U^ᴥ^U

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: How is she doing?
We just finished her physical, and she's sleeping.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Did everything go smoothly during the physical?
I discovered cats are rather feisty animals.
I found out it hurts something fierce when a cat bites you.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Hahahaha

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Am I the only one who finds this hilarious?
Leon's messages remind me of Timi.
How is Timi during his physicals?

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Timi?

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: He's always super calm.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: There's nothing to worry about with him.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: He wouldn't harm a fly.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: If you're curious, you can come and watch his next physical.
... No thanks.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Ouch!

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: You didn't have to shoot me down so quickly.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: How come Nero hasn't been sending any messages?

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Isn't she with you, Zoo Keeper?
She's fast asleep and purring like a diesel engine.
She passed out.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Excuse me?!
Sorry, what I mean is that she's sleeping.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Oh... you got me for a moment.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: I thought she had fainted or something UㅜᴥㅜU

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: I can see how she'd be pretty pooped.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Apparently, she was out in the rain for hours on end.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: She was?

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: But Nero hates the rain.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Nero and Zoo Keeper really went the extra mile this time around.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: That they did.

lines.speaker: biscuit
lines.text: Be careful that you don't catch a cold.
I'm fine.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: You say that, but put on an extra layer or two just to make sure.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: The results from Ruru's physical will be ready soon.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Let me know when you've got them.

lines.speaker: leona
lines.text: Biscuit and I will be waiting.
Okay.
